## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta12

### Refresh installation defaults and documentation
- Use the current thin-line map appearance as the visual default for newly created cards, including white background, low-opacity legend, zone/trail opacity, marker scales and current map colors.
- Make Zone, Off-limit, VF-off, Channel, Gate area, Dock and Custom area border widths default to 1.5 px and connect those width settings to the static SVG renderer.
- Use slider controls for all map border widths, including Custom area border width.
- Keep the established Gate area and Custom area default color `#8e24aa` and use explicit `#808080` for the Channel color picker.
- Replace the README example image with a current real card screenshot.
- Rewrite the README around the current architecture and feature set: backend-prepared Current cycle rendering, History, Notifications, mower controls, Custom Areas, Settings and native/Navimower Schedule handling.
- Document that the Navimower schedule is configured on the mower Device first and then managed from the card.
- Remove obsolete experimental-map documentation from the README.

Scheduler behavior, current-cycle ownership and completed History geometry remain integration-owned; this release only standardizes their presentation and documentation.
